title: After nearly 100 updates, here is Fink! My Platform for Engaging Educational Games. $150 Game Jam!
author: Worth_Bodybuilder_83
selftext:
Hello everyone! My name is Marcus, I'm a Senior at my University for Computer Science and Philosophy. Sometimes I go by Lain. 

What is Fink?  
  
Fink is a gaming platform where every game teaches something, and the time you spend thinking in them goes on your record as XP (1 XP = 1 minute of skilled thought). Fink is what happens when you follow the childlike urge to gamify everything. It works in the browser, and via an application. 

I built most of Fink with Claude. The city, the server that scores XP and the website all came out of Claude Code sessions, with me directing and play-testing piece-by-piece. I want to allow Fink games to be built from the community in the same way. Have your LLM make a game that teaches something, then upload the .html (or a .zip), or just paste the code. Fink hosts it at its own address and allows self-hosted games as well. There’s a starter kit with Fink’s fonts, colors and character (sprites and 3D) so your game looks like it belongs, plus an AGENTS.md you can hand straight to Claude Code, Cursor or Codex.  
  
Fink also has an on-device layer, where you can upload your documents locally to visualize them in a permanent 3D space. 'The Study' currently works on Mac and Windows. 

After working on this for most of the semester, I feel like it's finally time to post publicly about it. People are getting more wary of AI games, and I think that’s perfectly reasonable, but I also think those games need a space to flourish, so that’s what I’m trying to make.

Hence is why not only can anyone upload games, anyone can claim space in the underground to promote themselves or their work.

I built this platform intending to make a space where people would want to learn as well as express themselves. A learning community or a "learned society" is what I'm trying to build right now from the ground up. The smartest people at my Uni love Fink (yess!) and I'm opening the community up to the public to try and source more people who *also* will love Fink and build the community alongside me. 

**GAME JAM:**  
Make a game that teaches one real skill and enter it in the Fink Game Jam by **December 1st**. AI-assisted games are welcome, as long as a human validated it and it actually teaches something. 1st place gets $75, 2nd gets $50, 3rd gets $25, and the top ten get a permanent building in Fink’s city. Not a dev? Come play, earn some XP, and show off. 

**Join the Discord and drop your jam idea in #game-jam. I’ll personally reply to every one:** [https://discord.gg/97Mp9a5kg](https://discord.gg/97Mp9a5kg)  
  
**Play Fink now:** [https://finkinc.space/home](https://finkinc.space/home)
